caption:
काजोल और अजय देवगन की दिवाली मस्ती ने सोशल मीडिया पर मचा दिया है गदर! 💥

काजोल ने सोशल मीडिया पर अपने परिवार और पति अजय देवगन के साथ दिवाली सेलिब्रेशन की एक झलक शेयर की है।

वीडियो में काजोल सफेद साड़ी में नजर आ रही हैं जिस पर पीले और काले बॉर्डर हैं, वहीं अजय देवगन ने सफेद कुर्ता-पायजामा पहना हुआ है।

क्लिप में काजोल किसी को निर्देश देती दिख रही हैं और अजय उनका ध्यान खींचने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।

काजोल ने कैप्शन में लिखा कि सबसे अच्छे पल वो होते हैं जिन्हें रिकॉर्ड नहीं किया जा सकता, साथ ही उन लोगों को भी हैप्पी दिवाली कहा जिन्होंने तस्वीरें पोस्ट नहीं कीं।

इससे पहले काजोल ने 5 नवंबर को मुंबई में फैशन डिजाइनर मनीष मल्होत्रा की दिवाली पार्टी की तस्वीरें भी शेयर की थीं।

आप लोगों को काजोल और अजय की जोड़ी कैसी लगती है, कमेंट करके बताओ! 👇✨

ctx.title: Kajol shares candid Diwali moment with Ajay Devgn, says best times often go undocumented
ctx.summary: Kajol gave fans a glimpse of her Diwali celebrations with husband Ajay Devgn and family.
ctx.text:
Fans have been getting glimpses of Bollywood's Diwali celebrations, and Kajol has now shared a peek into hers. The actor took to social media to share moments from her Diwali festivities with husband Ajay Devgn and family. The picture showed the couple enjoying a candid moment during the celebrations, with the puja arrangements visible in the background.
In the video, which she described as one of the best moments that often go undocumented, Kajol is seen wearing a white saree with yellow and black borders. Ajay, meanwhile, opted for a white kurta-pyjama for the occasion. In the clip, Kajol appears to be giving someone instructions while Ajay tries to get her attention.
She captioned the post, "The best times are those u just couldn’t record and keep a track of.. Happy Diwali to all those who didn’t post pics as well 😜 .. #diwalitimes #allaboutthatday."
Earlier, Kajol had shared pictures from fashion designer Manish Malhotra's star-studded Diwali party in Mumbai, which was held on November 5. The actor opted for a black saree featuring diamond-studded embellishments along the border and paired it with a diamond necklace. She also posed with Manish and filmmaker Karan Johar in some pictures. Sharing the photos, she captioned them, "The nineties called and said they wanted us back ;) Only Manish could’ve made it happen."
The party was attended by several Bollywood celebrities, including Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan, Kareena Kapoor Khan, Saif Ali Khan, Akshay Kumar and Janhvi Kapoor.
Kajol and Ajay Devgn got married on February 24, 1999. The couple first met on the sets of their 1995 film Hulchul and fell in love. They went on to work together in films such as Pyaar To Hona Hi Tha, Dil Kya Kare and Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior. They have two children, daughter Nysa Devgan and son Yug Devgan.
Kajol made her acting debut with the 1992 film Bekhudi and went on to become one of Hindi cinema's most popular actors. She is known for films such as Baazigar, Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, Gupt, Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham and Fanaa.
In recent years, she has explored different genres with projects such as The Trial, Do Patti and the horror film Maa. She was also seen in the 2025 thriller Sarzameen, which starred Prithviraj Sukumaran and Ibrahim Ali Khan. Kajol will next feature in Maharagni: Queen of Queens, an action film directed by Charan Tej Uppalapati.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
